translated_text: 26. IV. 40 My darling Little One, I called Spira again this morning and they told me that Egge, probably, had left... So I don't remember who with Bichal we can't talk on the landline (they told me there wasn't anyone there). All this seems a bit strange to me, don't you know the Colonel? I don't know that several of them are going to see him. Who do you want?!? If not him, who? I still haven't received anything. Not even the little card you promised me from Montpellier. Did you at least arrive safely? This morning I received a letter from Egge and Sari. Egge arrived at the Savoy Hotel. Carlton, you know, where we spent three such delightful days. He's thinking of setting up a business in this city and is considering visiting us a little later - Kreip depot - possible visit - Your parents are going Very well, my darling, tell the gentleman at the Consure that I am very worried and that I would like to have news of him as regularly as possible. I kiss you a thousand times on both cheeks and on the eyes... your [illegible] PS Bichal just called me, he tells me that Tires left for Apole the same day as you and that I must see Chief Ullect about you, who will surely pay. So I will go there tomorrow at 6 p.m. B. was very kind on the phone.
